 Chapter 5: SPICE Options and Controls
SPICE-Compatible Options

Feedback

Description
Use this option to run specific selected .ALTER statements from a list where
"list_command" can be either:
•

"list num": Specifies one or more .alter statements to execute

or
•

"list(num1:num2 num3 num4:num5)": Executes samples from num1 to num2, sample
num3, and samples from num4 to num5 (parentheses are optional).

Note:
Either single or double quotation marks are required around the list_command.
Examples
This example simulates .ALTER statements 5 and 18.
.option alter_select="list 5 18"

This example simulates .ALTER statements 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, and 11.
.option alter_select=’list(1:3 6 10:11)’ $ parentheses optional

aspec
Description
Sets ASPEC compatibility mode for SPICE characterization. See SPICE documentation for
details. The default value is 0.
Syntax
.option aspec=[0|1]

autostop
Description
Stops the transient analysis after calculating .MEASURE functions such as TRIG-TARG,
FIND-WHEN, and FROM-TO. This option can dramatically reduce CPU usage. This option

also can be used with any measure types. The result of the preceding measurement can
be used as the next measured parameter. This is a very useful option for testing corners.
Note:
If autostop is set to 1, then finesim_runtime_meas=1 by default.

====16440====
Description
Sets the output file format for saving transient analysis results, so waveform display tools,
such as Custom WaveView, can display the result. The supported formats are FSDB,
WDF, PSF, TR0, UTF, PSFASCII, and OUT. The default format is FSDB.
For finesim_output=none, the FineSim Pro tool keeps measuring data, while ignoring all
commands related with .PROBE and .option post.
Examples
Multiple values can be given to finesim_output and FineSim generates both output
formats at the same time. Note that multiple outputs is only supported for the following
formats: FSDB, WDF, UTF. Currently, TR0 and PSF are not supported.
.option finesim_output="fsdb utf"

The above example outputs both FSDB and UTF files during the simulation.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#==============================================================================
# run_sweep.sh  --  parallel one-job-per-corner FineSim PVT sweep
#
# Why a new version?
#   The original script submitted a single LSF (bsub) job that ran the entire
#   netlist in one finesim process.  FineSim executes the base (nominal) run
#   and every ".alter" PVT corner serially inside that one job, so the total
#   wall time grows with the number of corners and a single job queue slot
#   becomes the bottleneck.
#
#   This version discovers the corners (base + every ".alter <title>") and
#   submits ONE bsub job PER corner, so all corners run in parallel.
#
# How a single corner is selected?
#   FineSim's ".option alter_select" runs only the selected run(s).  The
#   1-based list index enumerates the base run and the .alter blocks in order:
#       list 1  ->  base / nominal run (statements before the first .alter)
#       list 2  ->  1st ".alter" block
#       list 3  ->  2nd ".alter" block
#       ...
#   The option is injected with the "-ifile" switch so the original netlist is
#   left completely unchanged.
#==============================================================================
set -u

# ---- tunable via environment (defaults = original values) ------------------
queue=${QUEUE:-fqueue3_analog}
cpu_core=${CPU_CORE:-4}
netlist="${1:-${NETLIST:-IsmOscTestSweep.sp}}"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# ---- resolve the netlist to an absolute path -------------------------------
if [ -f "$netlist" ] && [[ "$netlist" == /* ]]; then
    netlist_abs="$netlist"
elif [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist" ]; then
    netlist_abs="$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist"
else
    shopt -s nullglob
    sp_candidates=("$SCRIPT_DIR"/*.sp)
    shopt -u nullglob
    if [ "${#sp_candidates[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then
        netlist_abs="${sp_candidates[0]}"
        echo "NOTE: netlist not named '$netlist'; auto-detected: $netlist_abs"
    else
        echo "ERROR: netlist not found: '$netlist' (looked in: $SCRIPT_DIR)" >&2
        exit 1

alter_names=$(awk 'tolower($1)==".alter" {

                      $1=""
                      sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]*\$.*$/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", $0)

echo "Queue   : $queue   CPU core(s): $cpu_core"

    printf '.option alter_select="list %d"\n' "$sel" > "$corner_dir/alter_select.inc"

    bsub -q "$queue" -J "sweep_${name}" \
        "cd $corner_dir && finesim $netlist_abs -np $cpu_core -ifile $corner_dir/alter_select.inc > run.log 2>&1"

    printf '  [%d/%d] submitted %-24s alter_select="list %d" -> %s\n' \

done
```

#!/bin/bash
#==============================================================================
# run_sweep.sh  --  parallel one-job-per-corner FineSim PVT sweep
#
# Why a new version?
#   The original script submitted a single LSF (bsub) job that ran the whole
#   netlist in one finesim process.  FineSim executes the base (nominal) run
#   and every ".alter" PVT corner serially inside that one job, so total wall
#   time grows with the number of corners and a single queue slot becomes the
#   bottleneck.
#
#   This version discovers the corners (base + every ".alter <title>") and
#   submits ONE bsub job PER corner, so all corners run in parallel.
#
# How a single corner is selected?
#   FineSim's ".option alter_select" runs only the selected run(s).  The 1-based
#   list index enumerates the base run and the .alter blocks in order:
#       list 1  ->  base / nominal run (statements before the first .alter)
#       list 2  ->  1st ".alter" block
#       list 3  ->  2nd ".alter" block
#       ...
#   The option is injected with the "-ifile" switch, so the original netlist is
#   left completely unchanged.
#==============================================================================
set -u

# ---- tunable via environment (defaults = original values) ------------------
queue=${QUEUE:-fqueue3_analog}
cpu_core=${CPU_CORE:-4}
netlist="${1:-${NETLIST:-IsmOscTestSweep.sp}}"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# ---- resolve the netlist to an absolute path -------------------------------
if [ -f "$netlist" ] && [[ "$netlist" == /* ]]; then
    netlist_abs="$netlist"
elif [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist" ]; then
    netlist_abs="$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist"
else
    shopt -s nullglob
    sp_candidates=("$SCRIPT_DIR"/*.sp)
    shopt -u nullglob
    if [ "${#sp_candidates[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then
        netlist_abs="${sp_candidates[0]}"
        echo "NOTE: netlist not named '$netlist'; auto-detected: $netlist_abs"
    else
        echo "ERROR: netlist not found: '$netlist' (looked in: $SCRIPT_DIR)" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# ---- output tree -----------------------------------------------------------
run_dir="$SCRIPT_DIR/superon_sweep_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$run_dir"

module unload primesim 2>/dev/null
module load prime/2023.12-SP4

# ---- discover the corners --------------------------------------------------
# Corner 1 is always the base/nominal run.  Remaining corners come from
# ".alter <title>" lines (case-insensitive) in the netlist.
alter_names=$(awk 'tolower($1)==".alter" {
                      n++
                      $1=""
                      sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]*\$.*$/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", $0)
                      if ($0=="") $0="alter" n
                      print $0
                  }' "$netlist_abs")

corner_names=("nominal")
if [ -n "$alter_names" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        [ -n "$line" ] && corner_names+=("$line")
    done <<< "$alter_names"
fi

sanitize() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | tr -c '[:alnum:]_.-' '_' | tr -s '_' | sed 's/^_//;s/_$//'
}

total=${#corner_names[@]}
echo "Netlist : $netlist_abs"
echo "Corners : $total (1 base/nominal + $((total-1)) .alter)"
echo "Queue   : $queue   CPU core(s): $cpu_core"

for ((i=0; i<total; i++)); do
    sel=$((i+1))                       # FineSim alter_select index (1-based)
    raw="${corner_names[$i]}"
    name=$(sanitize "$raw")
    [ -z "$name" ] && name="corner${sel}"

    corner_dir="$run_dir/${sel}_${name}"
    mkdir -p "$corner_dir"

    # control file selecting exactly this corner (list N = Nth run)
    printf '.option alter_select="list %d"\n' "$sel" > "$corner_dir/alter_select.inc"

    bsub -q "$queue" -J "sweep${sel}" \
        "cd $corner_dir && finesim $netlist_abs -np $cpu_core -ifile $corner_dir/alter_select.inc > run.log 2>&1"

    printf '  [%d/%d] submitted %-24s alter_select="list %d" -> %s\n' \
        "$sel" "$total" "$name" "$sel" "$corner_dir"
done

echo "Output directory: $run_dir"
echo "Submitted $total independent corner jobs (parallel)."

#   The original script submitted a single LSF (bsub) job that ran the whole
#   netlist in one finesim process.  FineSim executes the base (nominal) run
#   and every ".alter" PVT corner serially inside that one job, so total wall
#   time grows with the number of corners and a single queue slot becomes the
#   bottleneck.
#
#   This version discovers the corners (base + every ".alter <title>") and
#   submits ONE bsub job PER corner, so all corners run in parallel.
#
# How a single corner is selected?
#   FineSim's ".option alter_select" runs only the selected run(s).  The 1-based
#   list index enumerates the base run and the .alter blocks in order:
#       list 1  ->  base / nominal run (statements before the first .alter)
#       list 2  ->  1st ".alter" block
#       list 3  ->  2nd ".alter" block
#       ...
#   The option is injected with the "-ifile" switch, so the original netlist is
#   left completely unchanged.
#==============================================================================
set -u

cpu_core=${CPU_CORE:-4}

elif [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist" ]; then
    netlist_abs="$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist"
else
    shopt -s nullglob
    sp_candidates=("$SCRIPT_DIR"/*.sp)
    shopt -u nullglob

        netlist_abs="${sp_candidates[0]}"

```bash
cpu_core=${CPU_CORE:-4}

    else
        echo "ERROR: netlist not found: '$netlist' (looked in: $SCRIPT_DIR)" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

run_dir="$SCRIPT_DIR/superon_sweep_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$run_dir"

module unload primesim 2>/dev/null
module load prime/2023.12-SP4

alter_names=$(awk 'tolower($1)==".alter" {
                      n++
                      $1=""
                      sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]*\$.*$/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", $0)
                      if ($0=="") $0="alter" n
                      print $0

corner_names=("nominal")

    done <<< "$alter_names"
fi

sanitize() {

}

    [ -z "$name" ] && name="corner${sel}"

    mkdir -p "$corner_dir"

    # control file: .option alter_select="list N" selects exactly the Nth run
    printf '.option alter_select="list %d"\n' "$sel" > "$corner_dir/alter_select.inc"
```

#!/bin/bash
#===============================================================================
# run_sweep.sh  --  parallel, one-job-per-corner FineSim PVT sweep
#
#   原版：
#       单个 bsub 任务里跑一个 finesim，finesim 在同一个进程内把 base/nominal
#       与所有 ".alter" PVT corner 串行跑完 —— corner 越多，单个任务墙钟时间
#       越长，成为瓶颈。
#
#   本版：
#       自动发现 corner（base + 每一个 ".alter <title>"），每个 corner 提交
#       一个独立 bsub 任务，所有 corner 在 LSF 上并行执行。
#
# 单 corner 选择机制（FineSim 原生，不改网表）：
#   FineSim 的 ".option alter_select" 只运行指定的 run。索引从 1 开始，按顺序
#   枚举 base 与各 .alter 块：
#       list 1 -> base/nominal（第一个 .alter 之前的语句）
#       list 2 -> 第 1 个 ".alter" 块
#       list 3 -> 第 2 个 ".alter" 块
#       ...
#   该 option 通过 "-ifile" 注入，原始网表保持只读、不被修改。
#===============================================================================
set -u

# ---- 可用环境变量覆盖（默认值与原版一致） -------------------------------------
queue=${QUEUE:-fqueue3_analog}
cpu_core=${CPU_CORE:-4}
netlist="${1:-${NETLIST:-IsmOscTestSweep.sp}}"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# ---- 将网表解析为绝对路径 ----------------------------------------------------
if [ -f "$netlist" ] && [[ "$netlist" == /* ]]; then
    netlist_abs="$netlist"
elif [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist" ]; then
    netlist_abs="$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist"
else
    shopt -s nullglob
    sp_candidates=("$SCRIPT_DIR"/*.sp)
    shopt -u nullglob
    if [ "${#sp_candidates[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then
        netlist_abs="${sp_candidates[0]}"
        echo "NOTE: netlist not named '$netlist'; auto-detected: $netlist_abs"
    else
        echo "ERROR: netlist not found: '$netlist' (looked in: $SCRIPT_DIR)" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# ---- 输出目录（时间戳目录名与原版保持一致） -----------------------------------
run_dir="$SCRIPT_DIR/superon_sweep_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$run_dir"

module unload primesim 2>/dev/null
module load prime/2023.12-SP4

# ---- 发现 corner -------------------------------------------------------------
# 第 1 个 corner 恒为 base/nominal；其余来自网表中的 ".alter <title>"（不区分
# 大小写）。标题去注释、去首尾空白。
alter_names=$(awk 'tolower($1)==".alter" {
                      n++
                      $1=""
                      sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]*\$.*$/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", $0)
                      if ($0=="") $0="alter" n
                      print $0
                  }' "$netlist_abs")

corner_names=("nominal")
if [ -n "$alter_names" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        [ -n "$line" ] && corner_names+=("$line")
    done <<< "$alter_names"
fi

sanitize() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | tr -c '[:alnum:]_.-' '_' | tr -s '_' | sed 's/^_//;s/_$//'
}

total=${#corner_names[@]}
echo "Netlist : $netlist_abs"
echo "Corners : $total (1 base/nominal + $((total-1)) .alter)"
echo "Queue   : $queue   CPU core(s): $cpu_core"

for ((i=0; i<total; i++)); do
    sel=$((i+1))                      # FineSim alter_select 索引（1 基）
    raw="${corner_names[$i]}"
    name=$(sanitize "$raw")
    [ -z "$name" ] && name="corner${sel}"

    corner_dir="$run_dir/${sel}_${name}"
    mkdir -p "$corner_dir"

    # 控制文件：只选择这一个 corner（list N = 第 N 个 run）
    printf '.option alter_select="list %d"\n' "$sel" > "$corner_dir/alter_select.inc"

    # 注意："-ifile" 必须搭配 "-o"（否则 finesim 外壳会把 -ifile 的值误当成
    # 第二个输入网表而报 "two or more input file"）。"-o <name>" 同时让每个
    # corner 的输出前缀唯一、无冲突。
    bsub -q "$queue" -J "sweep${sel}" \
        "cd $corner_dir && finesim $netlist_abs -o ${name} -np $cpu_core -ifile $corner_dir/alter_select.inc > run.log 2>&1"

    printf '  [%d/%d] submitted %-24s alter_select="list %d" -> %s\n' \
        "$sel" "$total" "$name" "$sel" "$corner_dir"
done

echo "Output directory: $run_dir"
echo "Submitted $total independent corner jobs (parallel)."

#!/bin/bash
#===============================================================================
# run_sweep.sh  --  parallel, one-job-per-corner FineSim PVT sweep
#
#   原版：
#       单个 bsub 任务里跑一个 finesim，finesim 在同一个进程内把 base/nominal
#       与所有 ".alter" PVT corner 串行跑完 —— corner 越多，单个任务墙钟时间
#       越长，成为瓶颈。
#
#   本版：
#       自动发现 corner（base + 每一个 ".alter <title>"），每个 corner 提交
#       一个独立 bsub 任务，所有 corner 在 LSF 上并行执行。
#
# 单 corner 选择机制（FineSim 原生，不改网表）：
#   FineSim 的 ".option alter_select" 只运行指定的 run。索引从 1 开始，按顺序
#   枚举 base 与各 .alter 块：
#       list 1 -> base/nominal（第一个 .alter 之前的语句）
#       list 2 -> 第 1 个 ".alter" 块
#       list 3 -> 第 2 个 ".alter" 块
#       ...
#   该 option 通过 "-ifile" 注入，原始网表保持只读、不被修改。
#===============================================================================
set -u

# ---- 可用环境变量覆盖（默认值与原版一致） -------------------------------------
queue=${QUEUE:-fqueue3_analog}
cpu_core=${CPU_CORE:-4}
netlist="${1:-${NETLIST:-IsmOscTestSweep.sp}}"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# ---- 将网表解析为绝对路径 ----------------------------------------------------
if [ -f "$netlist" ] && [[ "$netlist" == /* ]]; then
    netlist_abs="$netlist"
elif [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist" ]; then
    netlist_abs="$SCRIPT_DIR/$netlist"
else
    shopt -s nullglob
    sp_candidates=("$SCRIPT_DIR"/*.sp)
    shopt -u nullglob
    if [ "${#sp_candidates[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then
        netlist_abs="${sp_candidates[0]}"
        echo "NOTE: netlist not named '$netlist'; auto-detected: $netlist_abs"
    else
        echo "ERROR: netlist not found: '$netlist' (looked in: $SCRIPT_DIR)" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# ---- 输出目录（时间戳目录名与原版保持一致） -----------------------------------
run_dir="$SCRIPT_DIR/superon_sweep_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$run_dir"

module unload primesim 2>/dev/null
module load prime/2023.12-SP4

# ---- 发现 corner -------------------------------------------------------------
# 第 1 个 corner 恒为 base/nominal；其余来自网表中的 ".alter <title>"（不区分
# 大小写）。标题去注释、去首尾空白。
alter_names=$(awk 'tolower($1)==".alter" {
                      n++
                      $1=""
                      sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]*\$.*$/, "", $0)
                      sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", $0)
                      if ($0=="") $0="alter" n
                      print $0
                  }' "$netlist_abs")

corner_names=("nominal")
if [ -n "$alter_names" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        [ -n "$line" ] && corner_names+=("$line")
    done <<< "$alter_names"
fi

sanitize() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | tr -c '[:alnum:]_.-' '_' | tr -s '_' | sed 's/^_//;s/_$//'
}

total=${#corner_names[@]}
echo "Netlist : $netlist_abs"
echo "Corners : $total (1 base/nominal + $((total-1)) .alter)"
echo "Queue   : $queue   CPU core(s): $cpu_core"

for ((i=0; i<total; i++)); do
    sel=$((i+1))                      # FineSim alter_select 索引（1 基）
    raw="${corner_names[$i]}"
    name=$(sanitize "$raw")
    [ -z "$name" ] && name="corner${sel}"

    corner_dir="$run_dir/${sel}_${name}"
    mkdir -p "$corner_dir"

    # 控制文件：只选择这一个 corner（list N = 第 N 个 run）
    printf '.option alter_select="list %d"\n' "$sel" > "$corner_dir/alter_select.inc"

    # 注意："-ifile" 必须搭配 "-o"（否则 finesim 外壳会把 -ifile 的值误当成
    # 第二个输入网表而报 "two or more input file"）。"-o <name>" 同时让每个
    # corner 的输出前缀唯一、无冲突。
    bsub -q "$queue" -J "sweep${sel}" \
        "cd $corner_dir && finesim $netlist_abs -o ${name} -np $cpu_core -ifile $corner_dir/alter_select.inc > run.log 2>&1"

    printf '  [%d/%d] submitted %-24s alter_select="list %d" -> %s\n' \
        "$sel" "$total" "$name" "$sel" "$corner_dir"
done

echo "Output directory: $run_dir"
echo "Submitted $total independent corner jobs (parallel)."

# run_sweep.sh 修改对比报告（串行 → 每 corner 一个并行 LSF 任务）

## 1. 问题
原版 `run_sweep.sh` 只提交 **1 个** `bsub` 任务，在该任务内用一次 `finesim`
将网表中的 base/nominal 运行与所有 `.alter` PVT corner **串行**跑完。
corner 越多，单个任务墙钟时间越长，且始终只占用一个 LSF 队列槽位，成为瓶颈。

本版把每个 corner 拆成 **1 个独立 `bsub` 任务**，全部 corner 在 LSF 上并行执行。

## 2. 与原版的 diff

```diff
--- run_sweep.sh.orig         （原版：单任务、串行）
+++ run_sweep.sh              （本版：每 corner 一个任务、并行）
@@
 #!/bin/bash
 
-queue=fqueue3_analog
-cpu_core=4
-
-netlist=IsmOscTestSweep.sp
-run_dir=superon_sweep_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
-
-mkdir -p "$run_dir"
-
-module unload primesim
-module load prime/2023.12-SP4
-
-bsub -q "$queue" "cd $PWD/$run_dir && finesim ../$netlist -np $cpu_core > run.log 2>&1"
-
-echo "Output directory: $run_dir"
+set -u
+
+# 默认值与原版一致，可用环境变量覆盖
+queue=${QUEUE:-fqueue3_analog}
+cpu_core=${CPU_CORE:-4}
+netlist="${1:-${NETLIST:-IsmOscTestSweep.sp}}"
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+# ...（网表绝对路径解析、自动发现 base + 各 .alter corner ...）
+
+run_dir="$SCRIPT_DIR/superon_sweep_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
+mkdir -p "$run_dir"
+
+module unload primesim 2>/dev/null
+module load prime/2023.12-SP4
+
+# 对每个 corner 生成独立目录 + alter_select.inc，各提交一个 bsub 任务
+for ((i=0; i<total; i++)); do
+    sel=$((i+1))
+    corner_dir="$run_dir/${sel}_${name}"
+    mkdir -p "$corner_dir"
+    printf '.option alter_select="list %d"\n' "$sel" > "$corner_dir/alter_select.inc"
+    bsub -q "$queue" -J "sweep${sel}" \
+        "cd $corner_dir && finesim $netlist_abs -o ${name} -np $cpu_core \
+         -ifile $corner_dir/alter_select.inc > run.log 2>&1"
+done
```

## 3. 关键改动点与必要性

| # | 改动 | 必要性 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 发现 corner：`awk` 扫描 `.alter <title>`，base 恒为第 1 个 corner | 每个 corner 需要一个独立任务，必须先知道 corner 列表；且对换「隐藏网表」同样适用（不硬编码 corner 名） |
| 2 | 每个 corner 一个 `bsub`（`-J sweep<N>`），各自 `cd` 到独立子目录再跑 finesim | 实现并行、输出互不覆盖 |
| 3 | 每任务注入 `.option alter_select="list N"`（经 `-ifile 文件`） | FineSim 原生只跑指定 run 的机制，1 基、含 base；用 `-ifile` 注入即可**不改原网表**（网表保持只读） |
| 4 | finesim 命令行加 `-o <corner名>` | 使用 `-ifile` 时必须给 `-o`，否则 finesim 外壳会把 `-ifile` 的值误当第二个输入网表，报 `two or more input file`；`-o` 同时让各 corner 输出前缀唯一 |
| 5 | 网表解析为绝对路径、`set -u`、`module unload ... 2>/dev/null` | 稳健性：脚本从任意目录/被 zip 解压目录调用都能定位网表；规避未定义变量；`primesim` 未加载时不报错 |
| 6 | 保留 `QUEUE`/`CPU_CORE` 默认值 `fqueue3_analog`/`4`，输出树目录名 `superon_sweep_YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS/` | 与原版行为/默认保持一致 |
